description: Don't Take My Word For It I say I filed as an official write-in candidate. Here's the proof, straight from the State of Arizona, not from me.These are screenshots from my account on the Arizona Candidate Portal — the Secretary of State's official system for candidate filings. I've blacked out my home and mailing addresses
paid_for_by: Paid for by Michael Dorland, out of his own pocket, which is why the site has a weird mixture of pictures on it
title: Don’t Take My Word For It - Dorland for Congress — Arizona's 6th District
